Card Q&A.a: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
Card Q&A.q: Multiple effects trigger when this card attacks. In what order do they activate?

An opponent's Digimon attacks, and its [When Attacking] effect causes a Digimon to be played by an effect.  I then activate the [All Turns] effect on my BT25-028 [Dianamon] and DNA digivolve into this card.  Can I activate this card's [When Attacking] [Counter] effect during the counter timing after that?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can.  However, if there is an [End of Attack] effect, it will be a derived triggering effect, therefore that effect will activate before the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect.
Card Q&A.q: This card attacks, and its [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect and [When Attacking] [Counter] effect trigger simultaneously.  If I activate the [When Attacking] [Counter] effect first and end this attack, can I then activate the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?

Card Q&A.a: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the counter timing, the counter timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.
Card Q&A.q: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, such attacks can be ended. "End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
If an attack is ended by an "end the attack" effect, do [End of Attack] effects still trigger?

Card Q&A.a: No. Only one [Counter] effect can be activated per an attack.
